momo.session: afternoon session: 10 specs run (budget used today: 10 of 20), 3 robust runs, 0 nominations
notes: The 10:23 morning session failed before running anything (no momo trials logged this morning), so this was the only session today. Main pulled to 55f6afb (lab journal PRs #23/#24); checkout clean, `.venv` present.
